card.name: Words after be sure, you'll, may
card.fires_on: Words that come right after a modal or advice opener, such as 'sure' and 'to' in 'Be sure to', 'you'll', or 'may occur' and 'can cause' in warnings. Also partway through a few medical words like myelosuppression and bradycardia.

modes.label: Advice openers
modes.description: Words in 'be sure to' or "you'll" that lead into a tip to the reader.
modes.example: A Lexan wall separates the species. Be<< sure>> to take the time to explore the Exploration

modes.label: Warning verbs
modes.description: The verb after may or can in adverse reaction statements.
modes.example: Penpulimab-kcqx can<< cause>> immune-mediated rash or dermatitis.

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of long medical words.

card.writes: It favors Chinese phrases like 'if you' and 'you need', so it points the text toward addressing the reader directly.
card.plain: It fires on words that lead into a tip for the reader or a 'may occur' warning.
